stage0040_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$アンディ$$
「...Still, from Operation Yashima to the
　$$マリーメイア$$ rebellion, crisis after crisis.」

stage0040_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$モロイ$$
「And in space, Neo Zeon's declared war, huh...」

stage0040_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Oh right, what happened to the $$大統領$$
　and the others who went to talk with Neo Zeon?」

stage0040_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I heard they're still negotiating a wartime
　treaty with the Neo Zeon side.」

stage0040_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$カイエン$$
「He's good...
　that man, $$シャア・アズナブル$$...」

stage0040_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Right now the Federation forces are held
　by so-called Earth supremacists.」

stage0040_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$カイエン$$
「If we're unlucky, they might even launch
　indiscriminate attacks on space colonies.」

stage0040_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$モロイ$$
「I see...
　so first they'll pin down the $$大統領$$ and
　sign a wartime treaty banning indiscriminate attacks.」

stage0040_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「If its terms are sensible and humane,
　public opinion should welcome it too.」

stage0040_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$アンディ$$
「So all of that, from the declaration to
　this, is $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s blitz plan?」

stage0040_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「So it's really going to be war...」

stage0040_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$カイエン$$
「$c decided to watch the situation for now.
　No use us fretting about it here.」

stage0040_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Yeah.
　We're finally back at the academy after so
　long, so let's enjoy that for now.」

stage0040_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Oh right, rumor has it
　a transfer student's coming today...」

stage0040_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Alright, everyone... take your seats.
　It's been a while, Element first squad.」

stage0040_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Now then, let me introduce the transfer student.」

stage0040_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ジン$$
「I'm Akbarjin Badbayar.
　Nice to meet you...」

stage0040_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Akba... Akbarjin passed the Neo-DEAVA
　branch's training course with top marks, and
　is an Element cadet expected to perform right away.」

stage0040_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ジン$$
（Impersonating a transfer student was
　this easy, huh...
　Vega's security really is unreliable.）

stage0040_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ジン$$
（Well... I'm the one who hacked into that data.）

stage0040_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$スオミ$$
「Things have gotten hectic in space, but
　please all get along with him.」

stage0040_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Wonder if he's into holes? Hope so!」

stage0040_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Yeah, well...
　I doubt there are many people like that...」

stage0040_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「He's totally a bottom, a bottom!
　But what if that's just a front for a top?
　No way!」

stage0040_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「I hope he doesn't rub off on our boys...」

stage0040_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「What's up... staring at the transfer
　student like that? Is he your type?」

stage0040_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「N-no, it's not that... I just remembered.
　I was a transfer student too...」

stage0040_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$カイエン$$
「...Hey, transfer student.
　Heard you got registered to first squad too.」

stage0040_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ジン$$
（Otherwise I couldn't get close to the
　$$レア・イグラー$$ riding the Mechanical Angel.）

stage0040_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ジン$$
「Going to show me around the academy?」

stage0040_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$カイエン$$
「...Not that.
　It's club activities.」

stage0040_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text: ～ Municipal Junior High School No. 1 Schoolyard ～

stage0040_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$扇$$
「Right... this Akbarjin here is 14,
　same age as the rest of you, so he'll be
　attending this Junior High School No. 1.」

stage0040_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$トウジ$$
「What, so he's younger than $$アマタ$$
　and $$アンディ$$?」

stage0040_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But that's amazing...
　an Element cadet, and the same age as us.」

stage0040_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Kinda rich coming from you,
　when you're the one piloting an EVA.」

stage0040_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Teach $$扇$$,
　it's a pain, let's just call him $$ジン$$, yeah?」

stage0040_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$扇$$
「Alright, $$ジン$$...
　here at Junior High School No. 1, these
　five will be looking after you.」

stage0040_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$扇$$
「You'll have Element training at Holy Angel
　Academy too, but do your best here as well.」

stage0040_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ジン$$
（Careless of me...
　Kept apart from the Mechanical Angel pilots...）

stage0040_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ジン$$
（Looks like I'll need to consider
　a more forceful approach, and soon.）

stage0040_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$扇$$
「Horaki...
　I've got a staff meeting, take it from here?」

stage0040_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ヒカリ$$
「It's fine.
　Chidori's group will be here soon too.」

stage0040_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$扇$$
「Alright, $$ジン$$...
　make the most of it and learn plenty here.」

stage0040_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Dunno the details, but after that Odaiba
　incident, $$カレン$$ came rushing to school,
　crying that $$扇$$'s amazing, so admirable.」

stage0040_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$トウジ$$
「And that flipped a switch, made him
　an even more devoted teacher than before?」

stage0040_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Those A21 people...
　$$カレン$$'s worried about it, huh...）

stage0040_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ジン$$
「You're the pilot of an Evangelion?」

stage0040_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ジン$$
（Unbelievable...
　the pilot of that obviously vicious machine
　turns out to be such a frail little kid...）

stage0040_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ジン$$
（No, I can't let my guard down.
　This guy's bound to be some kind of savage
　beast who snaps in an instant...!）

stage0040_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Are you into that kind of thing too, $$ジン$$?」

stage0040_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$トウジ$$
「What's with you?
　Didn't hear what $$ケンスケ$$ said?」

stage0040_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ジン$$
「I'm not obligated to answer such a pointless question.」

stage0040_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ヒカリ$$
「Cut it out, Suzuhara.
　$$ジン$$'s still nervous, he just transferred in.」

stage0040_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「What's with this guy... seems bad with girls.」

stage0040_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$トウジ$$
「If he sees Class Rep as a girl,
　he must've been starved for female company.」

stage0040_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「By the way, there's one more
　EVA pilot here too.」

stage0040_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ジン$$
（Physical traits of a $$レア・イグラー$$...
　and a pretty high-level one at that...）

stage0040_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ジン$$
（J-just looking makes me feel strange...）

stage0040_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$シンジ$$
「E-everyone... the Jindai High folks are here.」

stage0040_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone.
　Let's start today's activity.」

stage0040_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$トウジ$$
「$$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$ aren't here though.」

stage0040_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$アルト$$
「It's a rare day off.
　Those two went out with friends.」

stage0040_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$n
「Playing's a kid's job too, after all.
　Today's Volunteer Club is just us then.」

stage0040_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$アンディ$$
「...We've got a rare day off too, y'know...」

stage0040_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「No complaining.
　Helping society matters a great deal, you know.」

stage0040_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ヒカリ$$
「I think so too.
　$c must have it rough as well, but
　please do your best too, $$アンディ$$.」

stage0040_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Come on, come on!
　Show me your good side too, $$アンディ$$.」

stage0040_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「When the Class Rep trio says so,
　you've got no choice, $$アンディ$$.」

stage0040_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Alright, fine...!
　So, what's today's activity?」

stage0040_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$アルト$$
「Picking up trash on the beach.」

stage0040_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$アンディ$$
「My motivation just deflated instantly...」

stage0040_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$宗介$$
「No problem, $$アンディ$$.
　We were originally Class 2-4's trash duty.」

stage0040_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$宗介$$
「This mission is an extension of that.
　In other words, a perfect chance for us
　to display professional-grade skill.」

stage0040_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$宗介$$
「Good spirit, Aida.
　The rest of you, follow suit.」

stage0040_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Fine, I get it!
　I'll do it, I'll just do it!」

stage0040_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ジン$$
（Volunteering... service work, in other
　words. Doing this on top of combat duty,
　how tiresome...）

stage0040_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$カレン$$
「So you're the rumored Akb... whatchamacallit.」

stage0040_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$トウジ$$
「$$カレン$$ Boss,
　you can just call him $$ジン$$.」

stage0040_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$カレン$$
「Then we'll call you $$ジン$$ too.」

stage0040_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$n
「Is he blushing...?
　Hard to believe, with $$カレン$$ no less...」

stage0040_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$甲児$$
「He just doesn't know $$カレン$$'s true colors.」

stage0040_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$宗介$$
「True.
　Turning pale from fear I'd understand, but
　turning red calls for concern instead.」

stage0040_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$カレン$$
「I can hear you, you two.」

stage0040_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$カレン$$
「Especially you, $n...!
　The nerve, saying that just because
　Miss $$スズネ$$ stepped out!」

stage0040_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$カレン$$
「Say something that hurts a girl,
　and think you'll get off easy...!
　I'm reporting this to Miss $$スズネ$$!」

stage0040_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$宗介$$
（Act like that, and this is the reputation you earn.）

stage0040_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$甲児$$
（Stop it, $$宗介$$.
　Don't waste $n's noble sacrifice.）

stage0040_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$ジン$$, don't let those guys rub off on you.
　Stay sweet and honest, like $$シンジ$$.」

stage0040_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「For starters, maybe do something about those bangs?」

stage0040_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$カレン$$
「Heh... so $$ジン$$'s a pretty boy, huh.」

stage0040_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Nice.
　That fresh, innocent reaction.」

stage0040_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「$$サザンカ$$! Did you get a shot of that expression!?」

stage0040_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Nailed it!
　This feels like a hit, first in a while!」

stage0040_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$クラン$$
「Careful, $$ジン$$.
　$$サザンカ$$ plans to sell candid shots of you
　to the girls and pocket the cash.」

stage0040_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Photos of $$アルト$$, $$ミシェル$$, $$正太郎$$
　feel kind of sold out by now.
　Fresh material is always welcome!」

stage0040_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$n
「...$$ボス$$, $$ヌケ$$, and $$ムチャ$$ are
　posing over there, but...」

stage0040_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「I'm not interested in shooting subjects like that.」

stage0040_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Mm-hm, mm-hm...!
　Just as I thought.
　$$ジン$$... let's stick with that hairstyle.」

stage0040_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ジン$$
（What's going on...?
　I meant to hunt a $$レア・イグラー$$, but somehow
　I ended up being hunted by one instead...）

stage0040_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ジン$$
（I feel like I'm losing my mind...
　This isn't some cheap idea like
　'flip the script' or 'swap roles'...）

stage0040_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Everyone... doesn't mean any harm...
　They're welcoming you, $$ジン$$...
　so, um... don't be scared...」

stage0040_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$アマタ$$
「This is $$ユノハ$$'s Element ability, Optical Transparency.」

stage0040_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$アンディ$$
「What, they didn't teach you at the academy?
　It's the special power each Element has.」

stage0040_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ジン$$
（I get it...!
　That beam passing through the octahedron
　was this $$レア・イグラー$$'s power...!）

stage0040_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Miss $$ユノハ$$... she vanishes when she's embarrassed.」

stage0040_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I never properly introduced myself.
　I'm $$碇シンジ$$...
　Nice to meet you, $$ジン$$.」

stage0040_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ジン$$
（What is this guy...
　Might be nicer than I thought...）

stage0040_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$スズネ$$
「An Abductor's appeared in $$アクエリア市$$!
　$c's been ordered to sortie!」

stage0040_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Club's canceled!
　Everyone, move out!」

stage0040_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$甲児$$
「Ruining our day off like this...!
　Get ready, Abductor!」

stage0040_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「If the enemy's here, can't be helped.
　Take care, $$宗介$$.」

stage0040_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ジン$$
（Was a unit sent in
　to assist my mission...?）

stage0040_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「It's okay, $$ジン$$.
　We'll protect $$アクエリア市$$ and $$聖天使学園$$.」

stage0040_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Listen to you talk, $$シンジ$$!」

stage0040_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「As expected from the guy who saved $$第３新東京市$$!」

stage0040_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$シンジ$$
「That wasn't my strength alone...
　It's $c, everyone's strength.」

stage0040_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$シンジ$$
「So, $$ジン$$...
　you don't need to worry.」

stage0040_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Good work, everyone.
　Glad you're all safe, above everything.」

stage0040_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$宗介$$
「An unexpected hostile force appeared,
　but we handled it.」

stage0040_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「For now, we started the
　Volunteer Club's work without you.」

stage0040_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ヒカリ$$
「But we're short-handed,
　so it hasn't gone very far...」

stage0040_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$トウジ$$
「And that idiot $$ジン$$ keeps making
　excuses to skip out on us...」

stage0040_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ジン$$
「I didn't enroll at $$聖天使学園$$
　just to pick up trash.」

stage0040_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Don't you think it's a shame for
　a sea this pretty to be full of trash?」

stage0040_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$シンジ$$
「The sea in the world I came from was red,
　an environment nothing could live in.」

stage0040_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$シンジ$$
「So when I came to this world
　and saw the blue sea, I was so happy...」

stage0040_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ジン$$
（Now that I think of it, a blue sea
　only existed in legend on Altair...）

stage0040_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Let's do our best together, $$ジン$$.
　If we all pitch in, it'll be done quick.」

stage0040_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$トウジ$$
「All right...!
　This'll speed the work up a bit!」

stage0040_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「But at this point, a few more hands won't do much...」

stage0040_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$アルト$$
「Figured that'd be the case,
　so I lined up some extra hands.」

stage0040_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$朔哉$$
「What the hell, $$アルト$$...
　They said it was a crisis for Earth,
　but it turns out to be trash duty...」

stage0040_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「That's not entirely wrong.
　The trash problem, meaning the
　environment, concerns all of Earth.」

stage0040_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Mr. $$ジョニー$$ is right.
　So let's all do our best at trash pickup.」

stage0040_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Must be nice for you two...
　Turning anything into date material...」

stage0040_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「Since you can clean up this beautiful sea,
　I'm sure the darkness in your heart will clear too.」

stage0040_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Not something I want to hear from you two...」

stage0040_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$オードリー$$
「...I don't quite understand how you feel,
　but let's do what we can for now.」

stage0040_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I think $$オードリー$$'s right.」

stage0040_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I get it, $$朔哉$$... how you feel...!
　There's just way too many couples
　in $c to begin with!」

stage0040_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Quit talking nonsense
　and get to work, $$アンディ$$.」

stage0040_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Your slacking off is well documented.
　I'll watch you the whole time.」

stage0040_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Now, use your hole-digging skill to dig a trash pit.」

stage0040_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Damn it... damn iiiiit!!
　Am I seriously the only one left out!!」

stage0040_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$シン$$
「You want a girlfriend that badly, $$朔哉$$?」

stage0040_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$朔哉$$
「You've got $$ルナマリア$$ waiting in
　$$プラント$$, like you'd understand...」

stage0040_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Get shown this much of it
　all around me, it gets lonely...!」

stage0040_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$朔哉$$
「You're the last one who should talk,
　getting private lessons from Miss $$スズネ$$.」

stage0040_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$くらら$$
「Not happy having us two riding along?」

stage0040_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$葵$$
「Well then, as you wish,
　how about a private lesson from us too?」

stage0040_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$くらら$$
「You'd better brace yourself.
　We might not be as gentle as Miss $$スズネ$$.」

stage0040_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ジン$$
（What is with these people...
　They've got power to fend off me and $$カグラ$$,
　yet they're off flirting with $$レア・イグラー$$s...）

stage0040_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ジン$$
（Could this be the $$レア・イグラー$$'s power...!
　That's the secret to their strength!）

stage0040_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Let's do our best too, $$ジン$$.」

stage0040_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$カレン$$
「Oh... looks like you're fired up now.」

stage0040_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You took my advice
　and parted your bangs too. Well done.」

stage0040_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$カレン$$
「I knew it, being called cute
　got you all self-conscious, huh.」

stage0040_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ジン$$
（T-this is just because I feared
　rebelling would draw extra attention...）

stage0040_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Let's do our best, everyone!
　Once the trash pickup's done, $$郁絵$$'s
　homemade curry will be waiting for us!」

stage0040_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$n
「Guess there's nothing for it but to get fired up」

stage0040_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$アルト$$
「Attention, all! From the Volunteer Club president!
　Our mission is to wipe out every scrap
　of trash on this beach! Leave nothing behind!」

stage0040_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ジン$$
（Volunteering, surrounded by $$レア・イグラー$$s...
　What's happening to my infiltration mission...）

stage0040_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（You knew full well what would happen
　if you defied me, and yet
　still you came at me...）

stage0040_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（Heh heh... you haven't changed since
　we first met. Just like a stray dog...）

stage0040_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（Dreaming of someone dear, inside a nightmare...
　The one comfort in a world of despair, I suppose）

stage0040_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
（For now, lose yourself in it, $$カグラ$$...
　For when next you wake, you'll be reborn）

stage0040_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
???
「That's hardly a hobby to be proud of」

stage0040_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Taking it out on him
　isn't pleasant to watch, either」

stage0040_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$カヲル$$
「No matter how many times you try, some things
　don't change... You might get the same result again...」

stage0040_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Don't you think that to change something,
　you also need to change yourself?」

stage0040_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Heh heh... ten thousand and two thousand years...
　no, after twenty thousand and four thousand,
　I wonder what the result will be this time...」

stage0040_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I'm sorry, $$アマタ$$...
　I... don't understand myself anymore...」

stage0040_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Watching that person makes me so sad...
　I'm terrified, and yet... I feel this nostalgia...」

stage0040_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（A man and woman, out of step...
　Fond of each other, yet their too-long spring
　lets a cold draft blow between their hearts...）

stage0040_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（And into that gap steps another man...
　Ah... a maiden's heart torn a thousand ways...）

stage0040_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（This situation is too much...!
　Their heartbeats are churning out Z-Chips like crazy!）

stage0040_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（That sum... 150 Z!
　I'll add this to the squad's stockpile）

stage0040_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Now then, I'll enjoy watching the rest myself.
　Ah... where will these three's 12,000 years of love lead...）

stage0040_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Haven't you heard?
　I am $$ＤＥＭ$$'s agent,
　the dimensional trader beloved by all, $$ＡＧ$$.」

stage0040_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$ジン$$
（Even something like this is part of it...
　This unit called $c really is
　an unbelievably ragtag mixed bunch）

stage0040_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll say it plainly, you...
　you're hiding something!」

stage0040_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You have a secret mission...
　and that's why you infiltrated $c, isn't it?」

stage0040_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$ジン$$
（This guy... did he figure out my mission...?
　If so...）

stage0040_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah! You're planning to summon your
　vest and clogs by remote control, aren't you!」

stage0040_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just so you know,
　I'm not any kind of monster myself!」

stage0040_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you want to brag, then go ahead and brag!
　Just because you have no school or exams, argh!!」

stage0040_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Stop saying nonsensical things
　and troubling $$ジン$$!」

stage0040_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There it is! A western monster, the invisible man!
　Now, Master $$ジン$$... quick, use the fly hook!!」

stage0040_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Calling me a monster is so mean...」

stage0040_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「M-my apologies, Lady $$ユノハ$$!
　I let my joking go a bit too far!」

stage0040_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, Master $$ジン$$, you too!
　Please help me smooth this over!」

stage0040_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Here we go!
　Fired up today too, for Lady $$ユノハ$$'s sake!」

stage0040_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$ジン$$
（W-well, I don't really get it,
　but it seems like this worked out...）
